headline: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C for AI drug design
body: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug discovery startup founded by Demis Hassabis, has raised a $5 billion Series C, the company said. The round was co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital. Isomorphic last raised in May, with a $2.1 billion Series B.
note: For finance readers, the round is a sign of how much capital is moving into AI drug discovery: Dealroom counts $23.2 billion raised by drug discovery startups in 2026, a record.

figure.label: Series C raised by Isomorphic Labs

evidence.text: Isomorphic Labs, an artificial intelligence drug discovery startup founded by former Google DeepMind chief Demis Hassabis, has raised a $5 billion Series C, the company said on Tuesday.
The round was co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, alongside Andreessen Horowitz, with investment from Alphabet , Google's parent.
The fresh funds will help fund the design and development of new medicines using AI.
Isomorphic last raised in May, with a $2.1 billion Series B.
Drug discovery startups have raised $23.2 billion in 2026, according to deal-counting platform Dealroom, a record figure.
